prompt:
# Segment 1 (0-7.5s) - Intro to trigonometry
title = Text("Trigonometry", font_size=48).to_edge(UP)
triangle = Polygon([-2,-1,0], [2,-1,0], [0,2,0], color=WHITE)
self.play(Write(title), run_time=2)
self.play(Create(triangle), run_time=2)
self.wait(3.5)

# Segment 2 (7.5-15.7s) - Focus on right triangle
right_triangle = Polygon([-1,-1,0], [2,-1,0], [-1,1.5,0], color=BLUE)
right_angle = Square(side_length=0.3).move_to([-0.85,-0.85,0])
self.play(
    ReplacementTransform(triangle, right_triangle),
    Create(right_angle),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(5.2)

# Segment 3 (15.7-28.1s) - Highlighting hypotenuse
hyp_label = MathTex(r"\text{Hypotenuse}").next_to(right_triangle, RIGHT)
hyp_line = right_triangle.get_subcurve(0.33, 0.67)
hyp_line.set_color(YELLOW)
self.play(
    Create(hyp_line),
    Write(hyp_label),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(9.4)

# Segment 4 (28.1-44.6s) - Opposite and adjacent sides
angle = Arc(radius=0.5, start_angle=-PI/2, angle=PI/3, color=GREEN)
angle_label = MathTex("A").next_to(angle, RIGHT, buff=0.1)
opp_line = right_triangle.get_subcurve(0, 0.33).set_color(RED)
adj_line = right_triangle.get_subcurve(0.67, 1).set_color(BLUE)
opp_label = Text("Opposite", font_size=24).next_to(opp_line, LEFT)
adj_label = Text("Adjacent", font_size=24).next_to(adj_line, DOWN)

self.play(Create(angle), Write(angle_label), run_time=2)
self.play(
    Create(opp_line), Write(opp_label),
    Create(adj_line), Write(adj_label),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(11.5)

# Segment 5 (44.6-59.1s) - Introducing trig ratios
trig_ratios = VGroup(
    MathTex(r"\sin A = \frac{\text{opposite}}{\text{hypotenuse}}"),
    MathTex(r"\cos A = \frac{\text{adjacent}}{\text{hypotenuse}}"),
    MathTex(r"\tan A = \frac{\text{opposite}}{\text{adjacent}}")
).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.5).to_edge(RIGHT)

self.play(
    FadeOut(hyp_label),
    trig_ratios.animate.shift(LEFT * 2),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(11.5)

# Segment 6 (59.1-69.5s) - Sine ratio
sine_highlight = trig_ratios[0].copy().set_color(YELLOW)
self.play(
    Indicate(trig_ratios[0]),
    ReplacementTransform(trig_ratios[0], sine_highlight),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(7.5)

# Segment 7 (69.5-78.0s) - Cosine ratio
cosine_highlight = trig_ratios[1].copy().set_color(YELLOW)
self.play(
    Indicate(trig_ratios[1]),
    ReplacementTransform(trig_ratios[1], cosine_highlight),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(5.5)

# Segment 8 (78.0-87.8s) - Tangent ratio
tangent_highlight = trig_ratios[2].copy().set_color(YELLOW)
self.play(
    Indicate(trig_ratios[2]),
    ReplacementTransform(trig_ratios[2], tangent_highlight),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(6.8)

# Segment 9 (87.8-95.9s) - Emphasizing importance
final_group = VGroup(right_triangle, right_angle, angle, angle_label,
                    opp_line, adj_line, hyp_line,
                    sine_highlight, cosine_highlight, tangent_highlight)
self.play(
    Circumscribe(final_group, color=GOLD),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(5.1)

# Segment 1 (0.0-8.7s) - Intro to reciprocal trig ratios
title = Text("Reciprocal Trigonometric Identities", font_size=40).to_edge(UP)
subtitle = Text("Understanding the Relationships", font_size=32).next_to(title, DOWN)
self.play(Write(title), run_time=2)
self.play(FadeIn(subtitle), run_time=2)
self.wait(4.7)

# Segment 2 (8.7-16.2s) - Main reciprocal identities
identities = VGroup(
    MathTex(r"\csc A = \frac{1}{\sin A}"),
    MathTex(r"\sec A = \frac{1}{\cos A}"),
    MathTex(r"\cot A = \frac{1}{\tan A}")
).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.5).shift(DOWN)
self.play(Write(identities[0]), run_time=2.5)
self.play(Write(identities[1]), run_time=2.5)
self.play(Write(identities[2]), run_time=2.5)

# Segment 3 (16.2-23.0s) - Importance of relationships
box = SurroundingRectangle(identities, color=YELLOW)
self.play(Create(box), run_time=2)
self.play(Indicate(identities, color=BLUE), run_time=2.8)
self.wait(2)

# Segment 4 (23.0-31.1s) - Cosecant relationship
csc_eq = identities[0].copy()
self.play(
    FadeOut(identities[1:]),
    FadeOut(box),
    csc_eq.animate.move_to(ORIGIN).scale(1.5),
    run_time=2
)
csc_highlight = SurroundingRectangle(csc_eq, color=RED)
self.play(Create(csc_highlight), run_time=2)
self.wait(4.1)

# Segment 5 (31.1-40.0s) - Cosecant calculation
example = MathTex(r"\text{If }\sin A = 0.5,\text{ then }\csc A = \frac{1}{0.5} = 2").next_to(csc_eq, DOWN)
self.play(Write(example), run_time=3)
self.play(Indicate(example, color=GREEN), run_time=2)
self.wait(3.9)

# Segment 6 (40.0-48.4s) - Secant relationship
self.play(
    FadeOut(csc_eq),
    FadeOut(csc_highlight),
    FadeOut(example),
    run_time=1.5
)
sec_eq = identities[1].copy().move_to(ORIGIN).scale(1.5)
self.play(FadeIn(sec_eq), run_time=2)
sec_highlight = SurroundingRectangle(sec_eq, color=BLUE)
self.play(Create(sec_highlight), run_time=2)
self.wait(2.9)

# Segment 7 (48.4-53.5s) - Secant calculation
sec_example = MathTex(r"\text{If }\cos A = 0.5,\text{ then }\sec A = \frac{1}{0.5} = 2").next_to(sec_eq, DOWN)
self.play(Write(sec_example), run_time=3)
self.wait(2.1)

# Segment 8 (53.5-60.4s) - Cotangent relationship
self.play(
    FadeOut(sec_eq),
    FadeOut(sec_highlight),
    FadeOut(sec_example),
    run_time=1.5
)
cot_eq = identities[2].copy().move_to(ORIGIN).scale(1.5)
self.play(FadeIn(cot_eq), run_time=2)
cot_highlight = SurroundingRectangle(cot_eq, color=GREEN)
self.play(Create(cot_highlight), run_time=2)
self.wait(1.4)

# Segment 9 (60.4-65.9s) - Cotangent calculation
cot_example = MathTex(r"\text{If }\tan A = 2,\text{ then }\cot A = \frac{1}{2}").next_to(cot_eq, DOWN)
self.play(Write(cot_example), run_time=3)
self.wait(2.5)

# Segment 10 (65.9-80.2s) - Review all relationships
self.play(
    FadeOut(cot_eq),
    FadeOut(cot_highlight),
    FadeOut(cot_example),
    run_time=1.5
)
self.play(FadeIn(identities), run_time=2)
review_box = SurroundingRectangle(identities, color=YELLOW)
self.play(Create(review_box), run_time=2)
for i in range(3):
    self.play(Indicate(identities[i], color=BLUE), run_time=2)
self.wait(2.8)

# Segment 11 (80.2-89.4s) - Conclusion
conclusion = Text("Master these relationships for success in trigonometry!", 
                 font_size=32).next_to(identities, DOWN, buff=0.75)
self.play(Write(conclusion), run_time=3)
self.play(
    Circumscribe(VGroup(identities, conclusion), color=GOLD),
    run_time=2
)
self.wait(4.2)

section_title: Example: Proving Angle Equality from Sine Equality
prompt:
# Segment 1 (0-6.9s) - Introduction
title = Text("Proving Angle Equality from Sine Equality", font_size=40).to_edge(UP)
self.play(Write(title), run_time=2.5)
self.wait(4.4)

# Segment 2 (6.9-16.5s) - Statement of proof goal
proof_statement = MathTex(r"\sin B = \sin Q \implies B = Q").next_to(title, DOWN)
self.play(Write(proof_statement), run_time=3)
self.wait(6.6)

# Segment 3 (16.5-24.0s) - Introduce right triangles concept
triangle_template = VGroup(
    Line(ORIGIN, 3*RIGHT, color=WHITE),
    Line(3*RIGHT, 3*RIGHT + 2*UP, color=WHITE),
    Line(3*RIGHT + 2*UP, ORIGIN, color=WHITE),
    Square(side_length=0.4, color=WHITE).move_to(3*RIGHT)
).scale(0.5)
self.play(Create(triangle_template), run_time=3)
self.wait(4.5)

# Segment 4 (24.0-33.6s) - Show both triangles
triangle_abc = triangle_template.copy().shift(3*LEFT)
triangle_pqr = triangle_template.copy().shift(3*RIGHT)

labels_abc = VGroup(
    MathTex("A").next_to(triangle_abc, LEFT),
    MathTex("B").next_to(triangle_abc, UP),
    MathTex("C").next_to(triangle_abc, RIGHT)
)

labels_pqr = VGroup(
    MathTex("P").next_to(triangle_pqr, LEFT),
    MathTex("Q").next_to(triangle_pqr, UP),
    MathTex("R").next_to(triangle_pqr, RIGHT)
)

self.play(
    ReplacementTransform(triangle_template, triangle_abc),
    Create(triangle_pqr),
    Write(labels_abc),
    Write(labels_pqr),
    run_time=4
)
self.wait(5.6)

# Segment 5 (33.6-55.5s) - Show sine equality
sine_equation = MathTex(
    r"\sin B = \sin Q",
    r"\implies \frac{AC}{AB} = \frac{PR}{PQ}"
).next_to(proof_statement, DOWN, buff=0.8)

self.play(Write(sine_equation[0]), run_time=3)
self.wait(2)
self.play(Write(sine_equation[1]), run_time=3)
self.wait(13.9)

# Segment 6 (55.5-64.2s) - Rearrange equality
rearranged = MathTex(
    r"\frac{AC}{PR} = \frac{AB}{PQ}"
).next_to(sine_equation, DOWN)
self.play(Write(rearranged), run_time=3)
self.wait(5.6)

# Segment 7 (64.2-73.9s) - Introduce k
k_equations = MathTex(
    r"\frac{AC}{PR} = \frac{AB}{PQ} = k",
    r"\\AC = k \cdot PR",
    r"\\AB = k \cdot PQ"
).next_to(rearranged, DOWN)
self.play(Write(k_equations), run_time=4)
self.wait(5.7)

# Segment 8-10 (73.9-104.7s) - Pythagorean theorem
pythag = VGroup(
    MathTex(r"BC^2 = AB^2 - AC^2"),
    MathTex(r"BC = k\sqrt{PQ^2 - PR^2}"),
    MathTex(r"QR = \sqrt{PQ^2 - PR^2}")
).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.5).next_to(k_equations, DOWN)

self.play(Write(pythag[0]), run_time=3)
self.wait(5.4)
self.play(Write(pythag[1]), run_time=4)
self.wait(10.6)
self.play(Write(pythag[2]), run_time=3)
self.wait(4.8)

# Segment 11-12 (104.7-119.3s) - Ratio conclusion
ratio = MathTex(r"\frac{BC}{QR} = k").next_to(pythag, DOWN)
self.play(Write(ratio), run_time=3)
self.wait(3.4)

similar = Text("All corresponding sides have ratio k", font_size=36).next_to(ratio, DOWN)
self.play(Write(similar), run_time=3)
self.wait(5.3)

# Segment 13 (119.3-131.1s) - Similar triangles
conclusion1 = Text("Triangles ABC and PQR are similar", font_size=36).next_to(similar, DOWN)
self.play(Write(conclusion1), run_time=3)
self.wait(8.7)

# Segment 14 (131.1-146.3s) - Final conclusion
conclusion2 = MathTex(r"\therefore B = Q").next_to(conclusion1, DOWN)
box = SurroundingRectangle(conclusion2, color=YELLOW)
self.play(
    Write(conclusion2),
    Create(box),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(12.2)

section_title: Example: Evaluating cos²θ + sin²θ and cos²θ - sin²θ
prompt:
# Segment 1 (0-7.0s) - Introduction
title = Text("Trigonometric Identities Example", font_size=40).to_edge(UP)
subtitle = Text("Evaluating expressions with sine and cosine", font_size=32).next_to(title, DOWN)
self.play(Write(title), run_time=3)
self.play(FadeIn(subtitle), run_time=2)
self.wait(2)

# Segment 2 (7.0-17.7s) - Display expressions
expr1 = MathTex(r"\cos^2\theta + \sin^2\theta").shift(UP * 2)
expr2 = MathTex(r"\cos^2\theta - \sin^2\theta").shift(DOWN * 2)
self.play(Write(expr1), run_time=3)
self.play(Write(expr2), run_time=3)
self.wait(4.7)

# Segment 3 (17.7-23.6s) - Highlight goal
goal_box = SurroundingRectangle(expr1, color=YELLOW)
goal_text = Text("Pythagorean Identity", font_size=32).next_to(goal_box, RIGHT)
self.play(Create(goal_box), Write(goal_text), run_time=3)
self.wait(2.9)

# Segment 4 (23.6-40.0s) - Focus on first expression
self.play(
    FadeOut(goal_box),
    FadeOut(goal_text),
    FadeOut(expr2),
    expr1.animate.move_to(ORIGIN).scale(1.5),
    run_time=2
)
highlight1 = SurroundingRectangle(expr1, color=BLUE)
self.play(Create(highlight1), run_time=2)
self.wait(12.3)

# Segment 5 (40.0-47.4s) - Pythagorean identity
identity = MathTex(r"\cos^2\theta + \sin^2\theta = 1").next_to(expr1, DOWN)
self.play(Write(identity), run_time=3)
self.wait(4.4)

# Segment 6 (47.4-56.1s) - State identity
unit_circle = Circle(radius=2, color=WHITE).shift(RIGHT * 4)
self.play(Create(unit_circle), run_time=2)
self.wait(6.7)

# Segment 7 (56.1-65.3s) - Simplify first expression
result1 = MathTex(r"= 1").next_to(expr1, RIGHT)
self.play(
    Write(result1),
    expr1.animate.set_color(GREEN),
    run_time=2
)
self.wait(7.1)

# Segment 8 (65.3-80.6s) - Second expression
self.play(
    FadeOut(unit_circle),
    FadeOut(highlight1),
    FadeOut(identity),
    expr1.animate.scale(0.67).shift(UP * 2),
    result1.animate.scale(0.67).shift(UP * 2),
    run_time=2
)
expr2.move_to(ORIGIN)
self.play(FadeIn(expr2), run_time=2)
highlight2 = SurroundingRectangle(expr2, color=YELLOW)
self.play(Create(highlight2), run_time=2)
self.wait(9.3)

# Segment 9 (80.6-101.6s) - Explain second expression
alt_forms = VGroup(
    MathTex(r"= 2\cos^2\theta - 1"),
    MathTex(r"= 1 - 2\sin^2\theta")
).arrange(DOWN, buff=0.5).next_to(expr2, RIGHT)
self.play(Write(alt_forms[0]), run_time=3)
self.play(Write(alt_forms[1]), run_time=3)
self.wait(15)

# Segment 10 (101.6-116.0s) - Keep original form
self.play(
    FadeOut(alt_forms),
    expr2.animate.set_color(YELLOW),
    run_time=2
)
original_form = Text("Original form:", font_size=32).next_to(expr2, LEFT)
self.play(Write(original_form), run_time=2)
self.wait(10.4)

# Segment 11 (116.0-121.8s) - Importance of identities
importance = Text("Recognition of identities is key!", font_size=36).to_edge(DOWN)
self.play(Write(importance), run_time=3)
self.wait(2.8)

# Segment 12 (121.8-131.3s) - Compare expressions
compare_arrow = Arrow(expr1.get_bottom(), expr2.get_top(), color=WHITE)
self.play(Create(compare_arrow), run_time=2)
self.wait(7.5)

# Segment 13 (131.3-137.5s) - Final emphasis
final_box = SurroundingRectangle(VGroup(expr1, result1), color=GREEN)
self.play(Create(final_box), run_time=2)
self.wait(4.1)

# Segment 1 (0.0-6.5s) - Introduction
title = Text("Verifying Trigonometric Identities", font_size=40).to_edge(UP)
subtitle = Text("Example: 2sinA⋅cosA = 1 when tanA = 1", font_size=32).next_to(title, DOWN)
self.play(Write(title), run_time=3)
self.play(FadeIn(subtitle), run_time=2)
self.wait(1.5)

# Segment 2 (6.5-15.7s) - Present the identity
identity = MathTex(r"2\sin A \cos A = 1").shift(UP)
given = MathTex(r"\tan A = 1").next_to(identity, DOWN, buff=0.5)
self.play(Write(identity), run_time=4)
self.play(Write(given), run_time=3)
self.wait(2.3)

# Segment 3 (15.7-22.3s) - State first step
step1 = Text("Step 1: Find sinA and cosA", font_size=32).shift(DOWN)
self.play(Write(step1), run_time=3)
self.wait(3.5)

# Segment 4 (22.3-32.6s) - Draw right triangle
self.play(FadeOut(step1), run_time=1)
triangle = VGroup(
    Line(ORIGIN, RIGHT*3, color=WHITE),
    Line(RIGHT*3, UP*3, color=WHITE),
    Line(UP*3, ORIGIN, color=WHITE)
)
triangle.move_to(ORIGIN)
labels = VGroup(
    MathTex("1").next_to(triangle[0], DOWN),
    MathTex("1").next_to(triangle[1], RIGHT),
    MathTex("A").next_to(triangle, LEFT)
)
self.play(Create(triangle), run_time=4)
self.play(Write(labels), run_time=3)
self.wait(2.3)

# Segment 5 (32.6-47.9s) - Calculate hypotenuse
hyp_calc = MathTex(r"h^2 = 1^2 + 1^2 = 2").shift(2*RIGHT + 2*UP)
hyp_result = MathTex(r"h = \sqrt{2}").next_to(hyp_calc, DOWN)
hyp_line = MathTex(r"\sqrt{2}").move_to(triangle.get_center())
self.play(Write(hyp_calc), run_time=4)
self.play(Write(hyp_result), run_time=3)
self.play(FadeIn(hyp_line), run_time=3)
self.wait(5.4)

# Segment 6 (47.9-54.5s) - Transition to trig ratios
trig_title = Text("Finding sinA and cosA:", font_size=32).to_edge(LEFT)
self.play(
    FadeOut(hyp_calc), 
    FadeOut(hyp_result),
    Write(trig_title),
    run_time=3
)
self.wait(3.5)

# Segment 7 (54.5-62.1s) - Calculate sinA
sin_calc = MathTex(r"\sin A = \frac{\text{opp}}{\text{hyp}} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}").next_to(trig_title, DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT)
self.play(Write(sin_calc), run_time=4)
self.wait(3.7)

# Segment 8 (62.1-70.2s) - Calculate cosA
cos_calc = MathTex(r"\cos A = \frac{\text{adj}}{\text{hyp}} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}").next_to(sin_calc, DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT)
self.play(Write(cos_calc), run_time=4)
self.wait(4.1)

# Segment 9 (70.2-76.7s) - Prepare substitution
self.play(
    FadeOut(triangle), FadeOut(labels), FadeOut(hyp_line),
    FadeOut(trig_title), FadeOut(sin_calc), FadeOut(cos_calc),
    run_time=3
)
